transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Carter, the S-3, and I'll be publishing the final staffing roster for the coordination cell once we've completed our qualification scrub. As a reminder, the cell will run 0600 to 1800 each day of the four-day exercise, and we have three desks to fill: partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control. Our available personnel are Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega. Before I can publish the roster, I need to run the routine pre-exercise qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff. I need to confirm which of our three personnel hold current qualifications for each desk. Can the personnel shop provide the qualification records for Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sgt Malik is the only one of the three available personnel with a current host-nation language qualification, with a recorded proficiency score of exactly 92. I confirmed the renewal and score in the personnel database this morning, but the updated qualification export is not yet on the S-3 briefing slide.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I can speak to the POL accountability qualification. During my latest supply inspection, I verified that Cpl Ortiz is the only one of the three available personnel with current POL and hazardous-material accountability certification. The certification is valid through exactly 2026-09-30. However, I should note that the inspection update has not yet been entered in the roster tracker, so it may not appear in the current system export.
